1: [Gospel of Truth 16-17 — Joy of the Father]

The gospel of truth is joy for those who have received from the Father of truth the gift of knowing him, through the power of the Word that came forth from the pleroma, the one who is in the thought and the mind of the Father, that is, the one who is addressed as the Savior.
For that reason he is the one who is proclaimed through the aeons, the one who is in the mind of the Father and who is in his presence.
2: [Gospel of Truth 18 — The fruit of the tree]
For this reason, it is those who are from above who, through the Father's good pleasure, will be revealed. He was nailed to a tree and he became fruit of the knowledge of the Father.

This fruit did not, however, cause destruction because it was eaten, but rather to those who ate it it caused them to become joyful in the discovery, and he discovered them in himself, and they discovered him in themselves.
3: [Gospel of Truth 17, 24 — Error and the Father]

For this reason error became powerful; it worked on its own matter foolishly, not having known the truth. It set about making a creature, with all its might preparing, in beauty, the replacement of the truth.

Oblivion did not come into existence close to the Father, although it did come into existence because of him. For what comes into existence in him is knowledge, which appeared in order that oblivion might vanish and the Father might be known.
